description: TODO(author): what it reads from which service, what it hands on, and its bounds. GET only.

AUTH_HEADER.description: 'Bearer ' and a vault reference to the service's token, e.g. 'Bearer vault://<path>'. The platform puts the secret in the header; the module never sees it. Grant the installed copy exactly that path.

MAX_ITEMS.description: The most items to hand on, 1 to 100.

setup_instructions.title: Store the token
setup_instructions.detail: Store a read-only token for the service in the vault, and grant the installed copy exactly that path.
